caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock with a reddish-brown wooden case. The clock stands upright and has a rectangular body with a paneled door in the center portion. The top section, or hood, has an ornate, curved pediment with two scrolling designs on either side. The clock face is circular and features black numerals from 1 to 12 in a smaller inner ring and 5 to 60, in increments of five, in a larger outer ring. The background of the clock face is light-colored with metallic elements and has a smaller, additional circle just below the numeral 12, possibly depicting a secondary dial or decorative element. The lower section of the clock consists of a broader base with four short, curved legs. The overall composition places the clock in the center of a plain, off-white background with a thin black border enclosing the entire drawing. In the bottom right corner, the name “CORNELIUS W. FRAZIER DEL. 73” is inscribed.
title: Grandfather's Clock
